summary: Kerb where cars park, but homes 18-24 m away and bus zone signs line it.
reasons: Three cars parked along this kerb
Dwellings 18-24 m away on this side
Three bus zone signs along it

best_section.where: South kerb of the side street, east of the corner with the main road

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 8 m away at the corner end; further east nearest dwellings are 18-24 m and a retail building at 18 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars already park nose to tail on the kerb and a grass verge sits behind it; room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Side street just off a busy road with a bus stop at the corner.
drivers.convention: Parked cars on the kerb in both images, so a van would blend in.

flags: Bus zone signs at 2.5, 7.8 and 14.3 m
Bus stop and main road noise at the corner
sun_shade: Open kerb with sun most of the day; trees to the east shade the far end in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the bus zone is enforced
